en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a quiet street scene with wooden buildings and leafy trees. There is a person walking in the middle ground, and the area appears residential and tranquil. The style of the buildings and the overall setting suggests a small European town. The edges of the postcard are scalloped, typical of early- to mid-20th century postcards. At the bottom, there is printed text in both Swedish and Finnish.
